n=json.load(open('/app/output/initial/meta.json'))['proprio']['now'];q=np.array(n[:7]); T=np.eye(4);T[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',np.pi/2).as_matrix();T[:3,3]=[0,-.4,.78]
for a,d,al,qi in zip([0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088],[.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,0],[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2],q):
 U=np.eye(4);U[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('x',al).as_matrix();U[0,3]=a;V=np.eye(4);V[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',qi).as_matrix();V[2,3]=d;T=T@U@V
U=np.eye(4);U[2,3]=.2;U[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_euler('z',-np.pi/4).as_matrix();T=T@U
O=np.eye(4);O[:3,:3]=Rotation.from_quat(n[19:23],scalar_first=True).as_matrix();O[:3,3]=n[16:19]
print(T); print('Correction',O@np.linalg.inv(T));
